name: Tooltip
intent: Brief extra text on hover or keyboard focus of one trigger. Short and non-essential.
usage: Wrap one focusable kit piece, like a Button or an icon-only Button, in Tooltip and pass content. It shows after a short hover delay and at once on keyboard focus; Escape hides it. Keep it to a few words or one short sentence, and never put anything people must read or click in it. For a ? icon beside a field or setting, use HelpPopover; field help props already do. See contracts/tooltip.json for the full contract.

placement.note: Preferred side. It flips to the other side when there is no room, and stays inside the window.

delay.note: Milliseconds of hover before it shows. Keyboard focus shows it at once.

open.note: Controlled. true keeps it shown, false keeps it hidden.

disabled.note: No tooltip; the child renders on its own.

children.note: One focusable element, like a kit Button. It gets aria-describedby.

useWhen: A short hint on an icon button. For a ? help icon, use HelpPopover.
Extra context that would clutter the layout if always shown.
doNot: Do not invent Popover, HoverCard, InfoTip or a local tooltip. For a titled help panel, use HelpPopover.
Do not put required instructions in a tooltip. Use the field's hint.
Do not put links, buttons or forms in it. Use Modal.
Do not wrap something people cannot focus, like plain text or a disabled Button.
a11y: The text is always in the page as the trigger's description (aria-describedby), so screen readers read it on focus.
Shows on hover after the delay and at once on keyboard focus, not on a mouse click.
Escape hides it without moving focus or closing an enclosing Modal. The pointer can move onto the bubble to read it.
The bubble is fixed to the window, so scrolling containers, cards and tables never clip it.

examples.title: Placement
examples.usage: Hover or Tab to each button. It flips when the preferred side has no room.

examples.title: Icon button
examples.usage: The tooltip repeats the icon button's name for people who can see the screen.

examples.title: Longer text
examples.usage: Wraps past 256px. Keep it to one short sentence.
